insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: For SI of 1L and 2L: up to 1% of Base SI per day. For SI of 3L and above: no restriction except Suite or above room category is excluded.

icu.note: For SI of 1L and 2L: up to 2% of Base SI per day. For SI of 3L and above: covered up to Sum Insured.

copayment.note: Zone 2 is an optional lower-premium variant; 20% co-pay applies only for inpatient treatment in those cities. No co-pay under Zone 1.

sub_limits.note: Most benefits covered up to Sum Insured. Robotic surgeries (except radical prostatectomy, cardiac, partial nephrectomy, malignancy) capped at ₹1L. Emergency ambulance capped at ₹3,000 per hospitalisation.

deductible.note: No inbuilt deductible. Optional Annual Aggregate Deductible available at ₹25,000 / ₹50,000 / ₹1L / ₹2L / ₹3L / ₹5L / ₹10L.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents covered from day 1.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 36 months of continuous coverage. Portability credits applicable.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, kidney stones, osteoarthritis, etc.) excluded for 24 months. Accidents covered from day 1; cancer after 30-day wait.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard permanent exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording. I-Protect (optional) increases SI by 10%/yr but is not a no-claim bonus.

restoration.display: Once/yr, 100% of Base SI (different illness only)
restoration.note: Re-fill benefit reinstates up to 100% of Base SI once per policy year, but only for a different illness/injury than the one that exhausted the SI. Cannot be used for the same illness.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 90 days before admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 180 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Covered up to Sum Insured for procedures listed in Annexure VI.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered if patient cannot be moved or no hospital bed available; must continue for at least 3 consecutive days. Home Health Care Services also covered via empanelled providers post-hospitalisation.

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (inpatient in AYUSH hospital)
ayush.note: Ayurveda, Unani, Sidha and Homeopathy covered for inpatient care in recognised AYUSH hospitals. Pre/post-hospitalisation also covered for AYUSH treatment.

organ_donor.note: Medical expenses for living organ donor's inpatient treatment for organ harvesting covered. Stem cell donation excluded except bone marrow transplant.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹3,000 per hospitalisation for emergency surface transport.

modern_treatments.display: Covered; robotic surgeries sub-limited at ₹1L (select exceptions)
modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, etc.) covered up to SI. Robotic surgeries capped at ₹1L except prostatectomy, cardiac, partial nephrectomy, malignancy.

consumables.note: Consumables like gloves, masks, etc. are listed in Annexure II as non-payable items. No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: All benefits available in India only (Section 7.2.VIII). Treatment outside India is a specific exclusion (Section 6.2.XI).

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for annual/other modes and 15 days for monthly premium payment.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document; applicable on new policies, not renewals.

portability.note: Portability permitted as per IRDAI norms; credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods and moratorium transferable.

notable_exclusions.display: Overseas treatment, hormone replacement therapy, sleep disorders, STIs (non-HIV), external congenital anomaly, dental (non-accident), circumcision (non-medical)

optional_riders.display: I-Protect (10% SI increase/yr), Health Coach (wellness + renewal discount up to 20%), Personal Accident Cover (death/PTD/PPD), Annual Aggregate Deductible
